title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): AL developers can turn indexes on/off in AL code
summary: AL developers can now programmatically enable and disable database indexes in Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29), allowing app publishers to manage index performance tuning as part of their feature deployment.
key_points: In BC29, AL code can turn database indexes on or off, so app publishers can ship index management alongside their features.
Microsoft updated methods in codeunit 2000000029 Index Management; these match the actions on the Index Management page.
This builds on BC20 insights into missing indexes and on BC28 per-company index usage, cost viewing and turning indexes off.
The example turns off an index on table 21 Cust. Ledger Entry, using table 2000000041 Field to identify it.
features: Turn indexes on/off from AL code

quotes.text: AL developers can now turn indexes off/on from AL code. This allows app publishers to ship index management to match their features.
quotes.why_it_matters: It explains the core capability and its business value - developers now have programmatic control over indexes as part of application features.

quotes.text: Indexes are an effective feature in relational databases, like SQL, to speed up the process of finding data.
quotes.why_it_matters: It clarifies why index management matters for application performance and user experience.
